stamped-checklist:must/001.reason: All tracked object content is within the single repository root.

stamped-checklist:must/002.reason: The 54 maps and manifest are annexed under input/data; retrieval sources are recorded.

stamped-checklist:must/003.reason: The analysis dependencies are declared in the Pixi environment specification.

stamped-checklist:must/004.reason: Git tracks code, text, documentation and configuration at the committed state.

stamped-checklist:must/005.reason: git-annex stores binary inputs and outputs; no large binary blobs are stored directly in Git.

stamped-checklist:must/006.reason: The run log records a command, but no exact environment is linked to results; no lockfile is tracked.

stamped-checklist:must/007.reason: The root has no README.md or Makefile with installation and usage instructions.

stamped-checklist:must/008.reason: The report gives a reproduction command and names the analysis script.

stamped-checklist:must/009.reason: The analysis uses paths relative to its repository root.

stamped-checklist:must/010.reason: All nonstandard imports and analysis libraries are declared in Pixi.

stamped-checklist:must/011.reason: Pixi declares supported platforms; no additional host hardware, scheduler or system library is required.

stamped-checklist:must/012.reason: The environment specification lists Python, analysis packages and supported platforms; the report names the run command.

stamped-checklist:must/013.reason: The environment specification is committed with the analysis.

stamped-checklist:must/014.reason: No dependency-update or environment-regeneration process is documented.

stamped-checklist:must/015.reason: The committed Pixi file has mutable ranges and wildcards; no exact lock snapshot is tracked.

stamped-checklist:must/016.reason: A researcher can retrieve the exact commit and environment spec via the recorded Git/DataLad route.

stamped-checklist:must/017.reason: The report provides `pixi run`, but omits Pixi installation and environment retrieval instructions.

stamped-checklist:should/001.reason: Git and git-annex provide a shared versioned repository for text and large content.

stamped-checklist:should/002.reason: No CI or regular workflow test is defined.

stamped-checklist:should/003.reason: Inputs, code, results and environment are kept in distinct paths.

stamped-checklist:should/009.reason: N/A: the object contains no restricted data or software; sources identify public inputs and dependencies.

stamped-checklist:should/005.reason: The documented command reuses Pixi's environment; no per-run disposable environment is configured.

stamped-checklist:should/006.reason: There is no exact locked environment to reconstitute or regularly test; run logs do not record one.

stamped-checklist:should/007.reason: The environment is described by a spec but installed artifacts are not archived with the object.

stamped-checklist:should/008.reason: No update-and-track process is documented; this duplicates must/014.

stamped-checklist:may/001.reason: External source data are annexed as files rather than included or linked as submodules.

stamped-checklist:may/003.reason: Input, analysis and result boundaries are distinct, though there is no documented contract for updating them independently.

stamped-checklist:may/004.reason: The documented Pixi command composes the environment, inputs and analysis script into result generation.
